pages.text: $(bold)How.$() The sun left, the oceans froze, and you gave yourself heat stroke.$(br2)$(flavor)The Wellness Division has no pamphlet for this. We are improvising.$()

pages.title: Stages
pages.text: $(bold)60°C$(): Weakness I, orange tint$(br)$(bold)90°C$(): Weakness II, sweat, $(danger)1 heart/2 s$()$(br)$(bold)120°C$(): Nausea, Slowness II, $(danger)2 hearts/2 s$()
$(flavor)Stage names: "Sweating?", "Medium-Rare" and "I Am Cooked". 90°C poaches an egg. You are the egg.$()

pages.title: Causes
pages.text: Heaters share a target; more heaters add power, not heat.$(br2)Core warmth, campfires, lava and nearby open-camp heaters still heat you. A thermostat opens same-room Heat Vents, but can't switch those off.

pages.title: Armor
pages.text: Above 20°C, cold-weather armor traps heat:$(li)Insulated: +20%$(li)Heated: +40%$(li)EVA: +8%$(br2)An 80°C room reads $(bold)104°C$() in heated armor.

pages.title: Cooling Down
pages.text: $(li)Fit a $(l:heating/thermostat)Thermostat$(/l) and $(l:heating/heat_vent)Heat Vents$(/l)$(li)Move away from Core, lava or fire$(li)Wall heat cools slowly$(li)Keep EVA protection in vacuum
$(flavor)You survived the death of the sun and lost to your own heaters. Opening a vacuum base to cool off is not ORSA-approved.$()
